sentences.en: Hi, I'm Andrew Ross-Sorkin.
sentences.zh: 嗨，我是安德鲁·罗斯-索尔金。

sentences.en: I cover business and policy for DealBook, a daily newsletter at the New York Times.
sentences.zh: 我为《纽约时报》的每日简报《DealBook》报道商业和政策新闻。

sentences.en: On November 18th, I'm going to be interviewing some of the most consequential leaders in business, politics, and culture, including J.D.
sentences.zh: 11月18日，我将在纽约市举办的DealBook峰会上，现场采访几位商业、政治和文化领域最具影响力的领导人，包括J.D.

sentences.en: Vance, Elon Musk, Christine Lagarde, Zilran Mondani, and many others, live on stage at the DealBook Summit in New York City.
sentences.zh: 万斯、埃隆·马斯克、克里斯蒂娜·拉加德、齐尔兰·蒙达尼以及许多其他人。

sentences.en: You can watch some of these unguarded, unfiltered conversations as they happen.
sentences.zh: 您可以观看其中一些毫无防备、未经剪辑的对话实况。

sentences.en: We're going to be live-streaming select interviews for anyone to watch, free, at nytimes.com on November 18th.
sentences.zh: 11月18日，我们将在nytimes.com上免费直播部分精选采访，供所有人观看。

sentences.en: If you're not already a subscriber, you can download the New York Times app to watch and get a month of free access to all of our journalism.
sentences.zh: 如果您还不是订阅者，可以下载《纽约时报》应用程序进行观看，并获得我们所有新闻内容一个月的免费访问权限。

sentences.en: I hope you'll tune in.
sentences.zh: 希望您能准时收看。

sentences.en: You won't want to miss it.
sentences.zh: 您一定不想错过。

sentences.en: From the New York Times, I'm Michael Barbaro.
sentences.zh: 我是来自《纽约时报》的迈克尔·巴尔巴罗。

sentences.en: This is The Daily.
sentences.zh: 这是《每日新闻》节目。

sentences.en: Today.
sentences.zh: 今日话题。

sentences.en: The attack was brazen and exotic, but the target was a low-level spy living in retirement.
sentences.zh: 这次袭击既大胆又离奇，但目标却是一名过着退休生活的低级别间谍。

sentences.en: Why Russia may have risked so much to try to assassinate Sergei Skripal.
sentences.zh: 为什么俄罗斯可能冒这么大的风险去试图暗杀谢尔盖·斯克里帕尔。

sentences.en: It's Wednesday, September 12th.
sentences.zh: 今天是9月12日，星期三。

sentences.en: On March 4th, Sergei Skripal, a former Russian spy, was found on a park bench foaming at the mouth.
sentences.zh: 3月4日，前俄罗斯间谍谢尔盖·斯克里帕尔被发现倒在公园的长椅上，口吐白沫。

sentences.en: His daughter, Yulia, was slumped next to him.
sentences.zh: 他的女儿尤利娅瘫倒在他身边。

sentences.en: The sheriff agent used to attack the former double agent and his daughter was developed decades ago in the Soviet Union.
sentences.zh: 用于袭击这位前双面间谍及其女儿的神经毒剂是几十年前在苏联研制的。

sentences.en: Now, investigators have been dealing with this for more than a week,
sentences.zh: 现在，调查人员已经处理此事超过一周了，

sentences.en: and yet they still don't have a lot of answers as to why a former Russian spy and his daughter were poisoned and how exactly it happened.
sentences.zh: 但对于这位前俄罗斯间谍和他的女儿为何被毒害以及具体是如何发生的，他们仍然没有太多答案。

sentences.en: Why would Russia potentially target Skripal now after all these years?
sentences.zh: 为什么俄罗斯会在这么多年后还要针对斯克里帕尔？

sentences.en: Why would he be targeted now?
sentences.zh: 为什么他现在成了目标？

sentences.en: Why did they attack these two when they did?
sentences.zh: 为什么他们偏偏在这个时候袭击这两个人？

sentences.en: Why target Sergei Skripal?
sentences.zh: 为什么要针对谢尔盖·斯克里帕尔？

sentences.en: And if the attack on Sergei Skripal did come from Russia, why?
sentences.zh: 如果对谢尔盖·斯克里帕尔的袭击确实来自俄罗斯，那是为什么？

sentences.en: Ever since Sergei Skripal was poisoned with a military-grade nerve agent in the center of a small English town, we've been struggling with the question of why.
sentences.zh: 自从谢尔盖·斯克里帕尔在英国一个小镇中心被军用级神经毒剂毒害以来，我们一直纠结于“为什么”这个问题。

sentences.en: Why was this small-time spy who was pardoned long ago, who committed his crimes long ago, targeted with a highly exotic substance that appears to lead straight back to Russia?
sentences.zh: 为什么这个早已被赦免、罪行也早已犯下的无名小卒，会被一种显然直接指向俄罗斯的极其罕见的物质作为目标？

sentences.en: Michael Schwartz recently returned from reporting in Moscow.
sentences.zh: 迈克尔·施瓦茨最近刚从莫斯科的报道工作中回来。

sentences.en: What we found as we began pulling back the layers of his life is that this goes back to the waning days of the Soviet Union and what came afterwards.
sentences.zh: 当我们开始剥开他生活的层层面纱时，我们发现这可以追溯到苏联衰落的日子以及随后的时期。

sentences.en: The red flag came down over the Kremlin tonight as President Gorbachev resigned and brought to an end seven decades of communist rule in the Soviet Union.
sentences.zh: 今晚，随着戈尔巴乔夫总统辞职，克里姆林宫上空的红旗降下，结束了苏联七十年的共产主义统治。

sentences.en: The Soviet Union at this time was essentially dissolving.
sentences.zh: 当时的苏联实际上正在解体。

sentences.en: It was falling in on itself.
sentences.zh: 它正在从内部崩塌。

sentences.en: And Russia had this sprawling network of intelligence agents posted all around the world who suddenly found that they could no longer contact Moscow.
sentences.zh: 俄罗斯在全球各地拥有庞大的情报人员网络，他们突然发现自己无法再联系莫斯科了。

sentences.en: The instructions weren't getting through.
sentences.zh: 指令传达不过来了。

sentences.en: Their work was suddenly meaningless.
sentences.zh: 他们的工作突然变得毫无意义。

sentences.en: Their salaries began to dry up.
sentences.zh: 他们的薪水开始断供。

sentences.en: And all of a sudden, these people who had been accustomed to living under this rigid system of control from Moscow, where Moscow dictated everything,
sentences.zh: 突然之间，这些习惯了生活在莫斯科严密控制体系下、一切由莫斯科发号施令的人们，

sentences.en: all of a sudden they found that Moscow was absent.
sentences.zh: 突然发现莫斯科不在了。

sentences.en: Moscow was silent.
sentences.zh: 莫斯科沉默了。

sentences.en: And two of the spies that were trying to come to terms with the new rules of this period were Sergei Skripal, a mid-career officer with the Soviet Military Intelligence Agency,
sentences.zh: 当时试图适应这一时期新规则的间谍中，有两位是谢尔盖·斯克里帕尔，他是苏联军事情报局的一名中层官员，

sentences.en: and Vladimir Putin, who was a young KGB operative based in East Germany.
sentences.zh: 以及弗拉基米尔·普京，他当时是一名驻扎在东德的年轻克格勃特工。

sentences.en: Skripal was a colonel in the Russian Military Intelligence Agency based undercover in Madrid at the Russian embassy as a military attache.
sentences.zh: 斯克里帕尔是俄罗斯军事情报局的一名上校，以武官身份潜伏在马德里的俄罗斯大使馆。

sentences.en: And is he important?
sentences.zh: 他很重要吗？

sentences.en: I wouldn't call him incredibly important.
sentences.zh: 我不会说他非常重要。

sentences.en: He was a functionary in this intelligence apparatus that the Soviet Union and then Russia had established around the world.
sentences.zh: 他只是苏联以及后来的俄罗斯在世界各地建立的情报机构中的一名职员。

sentences.en: And how does Skripal respond to this sudden change in his country's status, the fall of the old Soviet Union?
sentences.zh: 那么斯克里帕尔对国家地位的这种突变，即旧苏联的解体，有什么反应？

sentences.en: We don't have a lot of details about his mindset during this time, but what we do know is that he immediately sets out to try and make money.
sentences.zh: 我们对他在这一时期的心态了解不多，但我们确实知道他立即着手尝试赚钱。

sentences.en: He engages in a number of business ventures, and eventually he entertains an offer to become a spy for the British,
sentences.zh: 他参与了一些商业冒险，最终他接受了成为英国间谍的提议，

sentences.en: selling Russia's secrets to the British Foreign Intelligence Agency, MI6.
sentences.zh: 向英国对外情报机构军情六处出售俄罗斯的秘密。

sentences.en: So essentially to betray Russia.
sentences.zh: 所以本质上是背叛了俄罗斯。

sentences.en: Correct.
sentences.zh: 没错。

sentences.en: And what motivates him to do that?
sentences.zh: 是什么促使他这样做？

sentences.en: As best we can tell, the motivation primarily is money.
sentences.zh: 据我们所知，动机主要是金钱。

sentences.en: And you have to understand the context of this time.
sentences.zh: 你必须理解当时的背景。

sentences.en: The Soviet Union collapsed.
sentences.zh: 苏联解体了。

sentences.en: Russia is run by a drunk president surrounded by a gaggle of oligarchs who have sapped up the nation's resources and industries and enriching themselves to an obscene degree.
sentences.zh: 俄罗斯由一位醉醺醺的总统领导，周围是一群榨干了国家资源和工业、以令人作呕的程度中饱私囊的寡头。

sentences.en: And you have intelligence officers who are selling secrets.
sentences.zh: 而你手下有情报官员在出卖秘密。

sentences.en: This is not something that's terribly uncommon at this time.
sentences.zh: 这在当时并不是什么特别罕见的事情。

sentences.en: Sounds like a free-for-all.
sentences.zh: 听起来像是一场混战。

sentences.en: It is a total free-for-all.
sentences.zh: 这完全是一场混战。

sentences.en: And Skripal wants a piece of this.
sentences.zh: 而斯克里帕尔想从中分一杯羹。

sentences.en: Putin does exactly the opposite.
sentences.zh: 普京的做法恰恰相反。

sentences.en: Putin is a mid-career KGB officer in Dresden.
sentences.zh: 普京是德累斯顿的一名克格勃中层官员。

sentences.en: He watches as the Berlin Wall falls.
sentences.zh: 他目睹了柏林墙的倒塌。

sentences.en: The East German government said tonight they were going to make more openings in the wall, at least a dozen more, put bulldozers right through the wall so that more people could
sentences.zh: 东德政府今晚表示，他们将在墙上开更多的口子，至少再开十几个，直接用推土机推倒围墙，以便更多的人能够

sentences.en: cross to the WeSt.
sentences.zh: 跨越到西方。

sentences.en: He watches as the East German government collapses.
sentences.zh: 他目睹了东德政府的崩溃。

sentences.en: And he watches as all of the contacts and colleagues he made while working in East Germany are rounded up.
sentences.zh: 他也目睹了他在东德工作期间建立的所有联系人和同事被一网打尽。

sentences.en: Some of them are arrested.
sentences.zh: 他们中的一些人被捕了。

sentences.en: Many of them are exposed.
sentences.zh: 许多人被曝光了。

sentences.en: And all the work that he devoted himself to for his entire career suddenly goes up in smoke.
sentences.zh: 他整个职业生涯所投入的所有心血突然化为乌有。

sentences.en: Hmm.
sentences.zh: 嗯。

sentences.en: He goes back to Russia.
sentences.zh: 他回到了俄罗斯。

sentences.en: He is not being paid.
sentences.zh: 他没有得到报酬。

sentences.en: He has very little to show for his career.
sentences.zh: 他的职业生涯几乎一无所获。

sentences.en: But the lesson he took from this era is that traitors are what, in large part, were responsible for the collapse of his country.
sentences.zh: 但他从那个时代吸取的教训是，叛徒在很大程度上是导致他国家崩溃的罪魁祸首。

sentences.en: His country was betrayed by its closest allies.
sentences.zh: 他的国家被最亲密的盟友背叛了。

sentences.en: His country was betrayed by its enemy, the West, was embarrassed.
sentences.zh: 他的国家被敌人——西方——背叛了，并因此蒙羞。

sentences.en: And he set about gathering together the strands of the Soviet Union and making a slow rise to power.
sentences.zh: 于是他着手将苏联的残余力量重新凝聚起来，并缓慢地崛起掌握权力。

sentences.en: And at first he does this in St. Petersburg, where he becomes a deputy for the governor of St. Petersburg.
sentences.zh: 起初他在圣彼得堡这样做，成为了圣彼得堡市长的副手。

sentences.en: And then...
sentences.zh: 然后……

sentences.en: Vladimir Vladimirovich Putin.
sentences.zh: 弗拉基米尔·弗拉基米罗维奇·普京。

sentences.en: Vladimir Putin took the oath of office on Sunday and became Russia's second democratically elected president.
sentences.zh: 弗拉基米尔·普京周日宣誓就职，成为俄罗斯第二位民选总统。

sentences.en: Vladimir Putin becomes president of Russia in 2000 and immediately begins to consolidate control.
sentences.zh: 弗拉基米尔·普京于2000年成为俄罗斯总统，并立即开始巩固控制权。

sentences.en: And that is the point in which he takes his vengeance on people like Skripal for betraying their country at its weakeSt.
sentences.zh: 就在那时，他开始向像斯克里帕尔这样在国家最虚弱时背叛国家的人进行报复。

sentences.en: Many are hoping Putin will meet his promise of fighting crime and corruption.
sentences.zh: 许多人希望普京能兑现他打击犯罪和腐败的承诺。

sentences.en: He goes after everyone he thinks has sold Russia out during this time.
sentences.zh: 他追捕了所有他认为在这一时期出卖了俄罗斯的人。

sentences.en: And there's a special attention paid to traitors.
sentences.zh: 而且特别关注叛徒。

sentences.en: Russian spies are arrested.
sentences.zh: 俄罗斯间谍被捕了。

sentences.en: They're put on trial.
sentences.zh: 他们被送上法庭。

sentences.en: By the Russian government.
sentences.zh: 由俄罗斯政府审判。

sentences.en: By the Russian government.
sentences.zh: 由俄罗斯政府审判。

sentences.en: And this is also a time that corresponds with the period when Skripal is probably working most closely with British intelligence to sell off Russian secrets.
sentences.zh: 这也恰好是斯克里帕尔可能与英国情报机构合作最密切、出卖俄罗斯秘密的时期。

sentences.en: And if I'm Skripal and I'm watching Putin begin to so aggressively go after spies who have done what Skripal did, which is betray Russia, I'm getting very nervous.
sentences.zh: 如果我是斯克里帕尔，看到普京开始如此激进地追捕那些做了斯克里帕尔所做之事（即背叛俄罗斯）的间谍，我会感到非常紧张。

sentences.en: I think that's right.
sentences.zh: 我想你是对的。

sentences.en: It would have been impossible for him not to know that the mood in the country had changed.
sentences.zh: 他不可能不知道国内的气氛已经变了。

sentences.en: This line of work had become increasingly dangerous for him.
sentences.zh: 这份工作对他来说变得越来越危险。

sentences.en: So what happens to Skripal?
sentences.zh: 那么斯克里帕尔后来怎么样了？

sentences.en: In 2004, agents with the Federal Security Service Counterintelligence Unit arrest Skripal.
sentences.zh: 2004年，联邦安全局反间谍部门的特工逮捕了斯克里帕尔。

sentences.en: He's put into a van and brought to Moscow's Lefortevo prison, which for years had been the prison in central Moscow where spies were held.
sentences.zh: 他被塞进一辆货车，带到了莫斯科的列福尔托沃监狱，多年来，那里一直是莫斯科市中心关押间谍的监狱。

sentences.en: He's put on trial and convicted of espionage and sentenced to 13 years.
sentences.zh: 他被送上法庭，因间谍罪被判处13年监禁。

sentences.en: So basically, he's discovered.
sentences.zh: 所以基本上，他被发现了。

sentences.en: He's found out.
sentences.zh: 他被识破了。

sentences.en: Given Putin's outspoken disgust for spies who betray Russia, I have to think that Skripal's life is basically over now.
sentences.zh: 鉴于普京对背叛俄罗斯的间谍毫不掩饰的厌恶，我不得不认为斯克里帕尔的生活现在基本结束了。

sentences.en: At this point, yes, his arrest and conviction mark the beginning of the slow disintegration of Skripal's family.
sentences.zh: 在这一点上，是的，他的被捕和定罪标志着斯克里帕尔家庭缓慢瓦解的开始。

sentences.en: Skripal is sent to a prison colony far from Moscow.
sentences.zh: 斯克里帕尔被送往远离莫斯科的监狱殖民地。

sentences.en: His wife contracts a uterine cancer and begins to die.
sentences.zh: 他的妻子患上了子宫癌，开始走向死亡。

sentences.en: His son quits his job, becomes an alcoholic and slowly drinks himself to death.
sentences.zh: 他的儿子辞去了工作，变成了酒鬼，最终酗酒而死。

sentences.en: And everything that Skripal knew, everything that gave him happiness, suddenly was lost to him.
sentences.zh: 斯克里帕尔所知道的一切，所有带给他幸福的一切，突然都离他而去了。

sentences.en: And then suddenly, something unexpected happened.
sentences.zh: 然后突然，意想不到的事情发生了。

sentences.en: One day in July 2010, guards came to his cell and told him he was being released.
sentences.zh: 2010年7月的一天，狱警来到他的牢房，告诉他他被释放了。

sentences.en: Hmm.
sentences.zh: 嗯。

sentences.en: Why?
sentences.zh: 为什么？

sentences.en: Vladimir Putin had changed.
sentences.zh: 弗拉基米尔·普京变了。

sentences.en: Striding into the opulence of the Grand Kremlin Palace, Dmitry Medvedev followed an age-old ritual reborn under Vladimir Putin.
sentences.zh: 德米特里·梅德韦杰夫大步走进富丽堂皇的克里姆林宫，遵循着在弗拉基米尔·普京领导下重生的古老仪式。

sentences.en: Vladimir Putin had been in power for two terms as president, and constitutionally, he had to step down.
sentences.zh: 弗拉基米尔·普京已经担任了两届总统，根据宪法，他必须下台。

sentences.en: He worked out this scheme whereby he traded places with one of his loyal deputies, a man by the name of Dmitry Medvedev.
sentences.zh: 他制定了一个计划，与他的一位忠实副手——一个名叫德米特里·梅德韦杰夫的人——交换了位置。

sentences.en: Putin became prime minister, and Medvedev became president.
sentences.zh: 普京成为总理，梅德韦杰夫成为总统。

sentences.en: But Putin's hand-picked successor showed no sign of being anything but his own man.
sentences.zh: 但普京亲自挑选的继任者并没有表现出任何不是他自己的人的迹象。

sentences.en: Medvedev set about reforming the relationship with the WeSt.
sentences.zh: 梅德韦杰夫着手改善与西方的关系。

sentences.en: We have done a lot to build confidence between our countries.
sentences.zh: 我们为建立两国之间的信任做了很多工作。

sentences.en: We have made steps aimed at establishing a more firm construction of our relations.
sentences.zh: 我们已经采取了旨在建立更稳固关系结构的步骤。

sentences.en: Barack Obama was president, and he developed a kind of rapport with Barack Obama.
sentences.zh: 巴拉克·奥巴马当时是总统，他与巴拉克·奥巴马建立了一种融洽的关系。

sentences.en: Our countries are more secure, and the world is safer when the United States and Russia get on well together.
sentences.zh: 当美国和俄罗斯相处融洽时，我们的国家更安全，世界也更安全。

sentences.en: And the Americans had arrested 10 undercover Russian agents who had been operating in the
sentences.zh: 美国人逮捕了10名潜伏在

sentences.en: United States for about 10 years.
sentences.zh: 美国境内约10年的俄罗斯卧底特工。

sentences.en: Now we move on to a story of the American suburbs and international intrigue.
sentences.zh: 现在我们转向一个关于美国郊区和国际阴谋的故事。

sentences.en: And both sides, the Obama administration and President Medvedev, decided they wanted to quickly resolve this issue.
sentences.zh: 双方，即奥巴马政府和梅德韦杰夫总统，都决定他们想尽快解决这个问题。

sentences.en: And so what they did was they negotiated a swap.
sentences.zh: 于是他们协商了一次交换。

sentences.en: The biggest spy swap since the end of the Cold War appears to have taken place in Vienna.
sentences.zh: 冷战结束以来最大规模的间谍交换似乎已经在维也纳发生。

sentences.en: Ten people who pleaded guilty of spying for Russia were deported from New York last night.
sentences.zh: 十名承认替俄罗斯从事间谍活动的人昨晚从纽约被驱逐出境。

sentences.en: These 10 Russian undercover agents would be sent back to Russia in exchange for four inmates who had been arrested for spying against Russia.
sentences.zh: 这10名俄罗斯卧底特工将被送回俄罗斯，以换取4名因从事反俄间谍活动而被捕的囚犯。

sentences.en: A short time ago, two planes involved in the swap, one Russian, one American, parked side by side on the tarmac at Vienna Airport for about an hour and a half as vehicles shuttled
sentences.zh: 不久前，参与交换的两架飞机，一架俄罗斯的，一架美国的，在维也纳机场的停机坪上并排停放了一个半小时，车辆在它们之间穿梭。

sentences.en: between them.
sentences.zh: 在他们之间穿梭。

sentences.en: And after his release, Kripal was put onto a U.S.
sentences.zh: 获释后，斯克里帕尔被送上一架美国

sentences.en: chartered plane on his way to London, toasting his freedom with champagne and whiskey with American agents.
sentences.zh: 包机前往伦敦，与美国特工一起用香槟和威士忌庆祝他的自由。

sentences.en: He was taken to London and then resettled in a small English town called Salisbury.
sentences.zh: 他被带到伦敦，随后被重新安置在英国一个叫索尔兹伯里的小镇。

sentences.en: — How does Putin feel about this swap and about people like Kripal being allowed to leave Russia despite what they've done?
sentences.zh: ——普京对这次交换以及像斯克里帕尔这样的人尽管做了那些事却被允许离开俄罗斯有何感想？

sentences.en: — Putin is clearly livid about it.
sentences.zh: ——普京显然对此非常愤怒。

sentences.en: He's livid about people who had betrayed the country were getting a free pass.
sentences.zh: 他对于那些背叛了国家的人竟然能轻易脱身感到愤怒。

sentences.en: And he envisions this very, very dark future for them.
sentences.zh: 他为他们设想了一个非常、非常黑暗的未来。

sentences.en: — He says in a press conference,
sentences.zh: ——他在新闻发布会上说，

sentences.en: — Quote, they'll have to hide their whole lives with no ability to speak with other people with their loved ones.
sentences.zh: ——引用他的话，他们将不得不隐姓埋名过一辈子，无法与其他人、与他们的亲人交谈。

sentences.en: — A person who chooses this fate will regret it a thousand times.
sentences.zh: ——选择这种命运的人会后悔一千次。

sentences.en: — You can see it in his facial expressions.
sentences.zh: ——你可以从他的面部表情中看出来。

sentences.en: His lip is curled and he is, he is, he's angry about this.
sentences.zh: 他的嘴唇在颤抖，他很生气，他对此感到愤怒。

sentences.en: — Does that quote from Putin, Michael, mean that a person like Sergei Skripal, even though
sentences.zh: ——迈克尔，普京的那番话是否意味着像谢尔盖·斯克里帕尔这样的人，尽管

sentences.en: he's now technically free, he's been swapped, does it basically mean that he's now a marked man by Putin's Russia, destined to be hunted down eventually?
sentences.zh: 他现在名义上自由了，他已经被交换了，这是否基本上意味着他现在是普京治下的俄罗斯的目标，注定最终会被追杀？

sentences.en: Or do the rules of a spy swap mean that somehow Skripal is kind of protected from Russia?
sentences.zh: 还是说间谍交换的规则意味着斯克里帕尔在某种程度上受到了保护，免受俄罗斯的伤害？

sentences.en: Perhaps there's like an understanding about all that.
sentences.zh: 也许关于这一切有一种默契。

sentences.en: — Until March 4th, 2018, it was generally accepted that if a spy had been swapped, that was the end of it.
sentences.zh: — 在2018年3月4日之前，人们普遍认为，如果一名间谍被交换，那一切就结束了。

sentences.en: — The person had been freed, they paid their debt, and these spies were to go off into their
sentences.zh: — 那个人已经重获自由，偿还了债务，这些间谍本应去过他们的

sentences.en: retirement, grow vegetables, grill sausages, and live a quiet life without fear of reprisal.
sentences.zh: 退休生活，种菜、烤香肠，过着平静的生活，不必担心遭到报复。

sentences.en: — But on March 2nd, two assassins were sent from Moscow to London, where at some point they
sentences.zh: — 但在3月2日，两名刺客从莫斯科被派往伦敦，他们在某个时间点

sentences.en: acquired a bottle of perfume loaded with a military-grade nerve agent.
sentences.zh: 获得了一瓶装有军用级神经毒剂的香水。

sentences.en: — They spent a day staking out Skripal's house in Salisbury, and at an appointed time on March 4th,
sentences.zh: — 他们花了一天时间在索尔兹伯里的斯克里帕尔家外蹲点，并在3月4日约定的时间，

sentences.en: went to Sergei Skripal's home and smeared the doorknob outside of his house with this military-grade nerve agent.
sentences.zh: 来到谢尔盖·斯克里帕尔的家，将这种军用级神经毒剂涂抹在他家门外的门把手上。

sentences.en: And the next thing that we know is that witnesses reported seeing two figures slumped on a bench, foaming at the mouth, twitching in the center of historic Salisbury.
sentences.zh: 我们接下来知道的是，有目击者报告看到两名身影瘫倒在长椅上，口吐白沫，在历史悠久的索尔兹伯里市中心抽搐。

sentences.en: And what British authorities believe happened is that at some point that day, Sergei Skripal and his
sentences.zh: 英国当局认为发生的情况是，那天晚些时候，谢尔盖·斯克里帕尔和他的

sentences.en: daughter, Julia, who was there visiting, had touched the doorknob and been exposed to this nerve agent.
sentences.zh: 女儿尤利娅（当时正在探望他）触碰了门把手，并接触到了这种神经毒剂。

sentences.en: And it took its effect and nearly killed them, if it weren't for the quick actions of British
sentences.zh: 毒剂发挥了作用，差点要了他们的命，如果不是英国

sentences.en: paramedics and medical officials who quickly identified that they were suffering the effects of a nerve agent.
sentences.zh: 医护人员和医疗官员迅速采取行动，及时识别出他们是神经毒剂中毒，后果不堪设想。

sentences.en: There was a tragic continuation to this story, though.
sentences.zh: 然而，这个故事还有一个悲剧性的后续。

sentences.en: So, long after British authorities had declared that all trace of this substance had been cleaned
sentences.zh: 在英国当局宣布这种物质的所有痕迹都已被清理干净很久之后，

sentences.en: up, a man by the name of Charlie Rowley picked up a perfume bottle that he recovered in some
sentences.zh: 一个名叫查理·罗利的人捡起了一瓶他在某个

sentences.en: kind of a dumpster, brought it home to his girlfriend, Dawn Sturgis, and presented it to her as a gift.
sentences.zh: 垃圾桶里发现的香水瓶，带回家送给了他的女友道恩·斯特吉斯作为礼物。

sentences.en: She then sprayed this substance onto her wrist, and this turned out to be the receptacle that the nerve agent was carried in.
sentences.zh: 她随后将这种物质喷在手腕上，而这正是装载神经毒剂的容器。

sentences.en: Both Charlie Rowley and Dawn Sturgis became extremely ill, and Dawn later died from the exposure.
sentences.zh: 查理·罗利和道恩·斯特吉斯都病得非常严重，道恩后来因接触毒剂而死亡。

sentences.en: And how does the British government respond to this?
sentences.zh: 英国政府对此有何回应？

sentences.en: The United Kingdom will now expel 23 Russian diplomats who have been identified as undeclared intelligence officers.
sentences.zh: 英国现在将驱逐23名被认定为未申报情报官员的俄罗斯外交官。

sentences.en: They have just one week to leave.
sentences.zh: 他们只有一周的时间离开。

sentences.en: The British government responds by expelling about two dozen Russian diplomats, and by this we mean probably intelligence officers, at least some.
sentences.zh: 英国政府的回应是驱逐了大约两打俄罗斯外交官，我们指的是可能是情报官员的人，至少其中一些是。

sentences.en: But it goes further than that.
sentences.zh: 但事情远不止于此。

sentences.en: France, Germany, Poland, and a host of other EU countries are taking similar action, with a total of 33 Russian diplomats expelled from European Union member states.
sentences.zh: 法国、德国、波兰以及其他许多欧盟国家也采取了类似行动，总共有33名俄罗斯外交官被欧盟成员国驱逐。

sentences.en: One by one, the countries of Europe announced that they too were going to expel Russian diplomats in response to this.
sentences.zh: 欧洲各国纷纷宣布，为了回应此事，他们也将驱逐俄罗斯外交官。

sentences.en: Ukraine, which is not an EU member, is also taking action.
sentences.zh: 非欧盟成员国的乌克兰也采取了行动。

sentences.en: Australia is said to expel two Russian diplomats.
sentences.zh: 据称澳大利亚将驱逐两名俄罗斯外交官。

sentences.en: Well, the United States is to expel some 60 Russian diplomats.
sentences.zh: 嗯，美国将驱逐约60名俄罗斯外交官。

sentences.en: The United States expels 60 diplomats at one time, which is an enormous number.
sentences.zh: 美国一次性驱逐了60名外交官，这是一个巨大的数字。

sentences.en: It is the largest expulsion of diplomats in American history.
sentences.zh: 这是美国历史上最大规模的外交官驱逐行动。

sentences.en: It also imposes sanctions on the Russian government.
sentences.zh: 它还对俄罗斯政府实施了制裁。

sentences.en: So the cost of this attack is incredibly high for Russia.
sentences.zh: 所以这次袭击对俄罗斯来说代价极其高昂。

sentences.en: Michael, why take that risk for just one person, one former spy, who, from everything you're
sentences.zh: 迈克尔，为什么为了仅仅一个人，一个前间谍，而冒这么大的风险？据你

sentences.en: describing, you know, is a retiree, essentially?
sentences.zh: 描述，他本质上已经退休了，不是吗？

sentences.en: Yeah, why risk it?
sentences.zh: 是啊，为什么要冒这个险？

sentences.en: It's what we've been wrestling with.
sentences.zh: 这正是我们一直在纠结的问题。

sentences.en: Why risk the backlash from the world by carrying out something so brazen?
sentences.zh: 为什么要通过执行如此明目张胆的事情来冒着遭受全球反弹的风险？

sentences.en: And if Putin is behind this, it just speaks to the ingrained loathing that he has for these traitors, that he's willing to risk all that this costs to go after them.
sentences.zh: 如果普京是幕后主使，这只能说明他对这些叛徒有着根深蒂固的憎恨，以至于他愿意冒着这一切代价去追杀他们。

sentences.en: And to what end?
sentences.zh: 目的是什么呢？

sentences.en: There's been speculation.
sentences.zh: 一直有各种猜测。

sentences.en: We don't know this for sure.
sentences.zh: 我们并不确定。

sentences.en: But a message to people of shaky loyalty, his own officers, who may be contemplating a similar
sentences.zh: 但这可能是给那些忠诚度动摇的人，也就是他自己的官员们发出的信息，他们可能正在考虑类似的

sentences.en: betrayal, a warning to the West that we can still do what we want.
sentences.zh: 背叛；也是给西方发出的警告：我们仍然可以做我们想做的事。

sentences.en: We can march into your country with this very dangerous substance and carry out an assassination operation against an enemy, and there's nothing you can do about it.
sentences.zh: 我们可以带着这种极其危险的物质进入你们的国家，对敌人执行暗杀行动，而你们对此无能为力。

sentences.en: So if the idea is to send a message, Michael, does Putin's government, in a sense, want the world to know that it carried out this attack?
sentences.zh: 所以，如果目的是为了传递信息，迈克尔，普京政府在某种意义上是否希望全世界都知道是它实施了这次袭击？

sentences.en: The more I think about it, Russia could have just as easily sent two men in to kill Skripal with a knife or a gun.
sentences.zh: 我越想越觉得，俄罗斯本可以同样轻松地派两个人用刀或枪杀死斯克里帕尔。

sentences.en: Instead, they chose a military-grade nerve agent that inevitably was traced back to the country that made it.
sentences.zh: 相反，他们选择了军用级神经毒剂，这不可避免地会追溯到制造它的国家。

sentences.en: Correct.
sentences.zh: 没错。

sentences.en: Putin is not a maniac.
sentences.zh: 普京不是疯子。

sentences.en: He understands the limits of his country's power.
sentences.zh: 他了解自己国家权力的极限。

sentences.en: But he is always probing for ways to project the power that his country has to its maximum effect.
sentences.zh: 但他总是在探索如何将他国家拥有的权力发挥到最大效果。

sentences.en: Like hacking the U.S.
sentences.zh: 就像黑客攻击美国

sentences.en: election, which must be another example of this.
sentences.zh: 大选，这一定是另一个例子。

sentences.en: That's very much an example of this.
sentences.zh: 这确实是一个很好的例子。

sentences.en: These are all things that the Russian government under
sentences.zh: 这些都是普京领导下的俄罗斯政府

sentences.en: Putin does to project the country's power.
sentences.zh: 为了彰显国家权力而做的事情。

sentences.en: Each time he does this, whether it be the election meddling in 2016, whether it be the attack on Sergei Skripal, he learns a little bit more about what the limits are.
sentences.zh: 他每次这样做，无论是2016年的干预选举，还是对谢尔盖·斯克里帕尔的袭击，他都会对权力的极限有更多的了解。

sentences.en: And he learns what costs are acceptable and what are unacceptable.
sentences.zh: 他会了解什么样的代价是可以接受的，什么样的代价是不可接受的。

sentences.en: You know, we don't know to what extent the sanctions imposed following the election meddling constitute an unacceptable cost for him.
sentences.zh: 你知道，我们不知道在干预选举后实施的制裁对他来说在多大程度上构成了不可接受的代价。

sentences.en: And we, it's yet to be seen whether the costs for poisoning Skripal were significant enough to prevent the Russian state, if it was involved
sentences.zh: 而且，我们还有待观察毒害斯克里帕尔的代价是否足以阻止俄罗斯国家（如果它确实参与了此事）

sentences.en: in this, from doing something like that in the future.
sentences.zh: 在未来做类似的事情。

sentences.en: I think in many ways, we've learned that Putin is continuing along the same track that he was on when we, when we met him.
sentences.zh: 我认为在很多方面，我们已经了解到普京正在沿着我们遇见他时所走的同一条轨道继续前进。

sentences.en: The aggrieved mid-career spy offended at Russia's debasement and trying to restore Russia's power and restore a sense of respect in the world for both himself and his country.
sentences.zh: 那个对俄罗斯的衰落感到不满、试图恢复俄罗斯的实力并为自己和国家重拾世界尊重的失意中年间谍。

sentences.en: I guess at almost any coSt.
sentences.zh: 我想几乎是不惜一切代价。

sentences.en: At almost any coSt. Michael, thank you very much.
sentences.zh: 几乎是不惜一切代价。迈克尔，非常感谢你。

sentences.en: You're welcome.
sentences.zh: 不客气。

sentences.en: British authorities have charged two Russian intelligence officers with the attempted assassination of Sergei Skripal.
sentences.zh: 英国当局已指控两名俄罗斯情报官员企图暗杀谢尔盖·斯克里帕尔。

sentences.en: In a speech to parliament, Prime Minister Theresa May said that the suspect's ties to the country's military intelligence unit, known as the GRU, suggest that the
sentences.zh: 在议会演讲中，首相特蕾莎·梅表示，嫌疑人与该国军事情报部门（即格鲁乌，GRU）的联系表明，

sentences.en: operation had been approved by the highest levels of Russian government.
sentences.zh: 这次行动得到了俄罗斯政府最高层的批准。

sentences.en: So this was not a rogue operation.
sentences.zh: 所以这不是一次流氓行动。

sentences.en: It was almost certainly also approved outside the GRU at a senior level of the Russian state.
sentences.zh: 它几乎可以肯定也得到了格鲁乌之外的俄罗斯国家高级别的批准。

sentences.en: Here's what else you need to know today.
sentences.zh: 以下是你今天还需要知道的其他消息。

sentences.en: On Tuesday, an American-backed military coalition began a final assault on the last territory under ISIS control in the region where the terror group was born.
sentences.zh: 周二，一个美国支持的军事联盟开始对恐怖组织诞生地地区仍处于“伊斯兰国”（ISIS）控制下的最后领土发动总攻。

sentences.en: The invasion of Hajin in eastern Syria marks the final chapter in a four-year campaign
sentences.zh: 对叙利亚东部哈金的入侵标志着一场为期四年战役的最后一章，

sentences.en: to oust the Islamic State from the land that it seized in Syria and Iraq in 2014, and where it had declared a caliphate from which ISIS had hoped it would take over the world.
sentences.zh: 旨在将“伊斯兰国”从其2014年在叙利亚和伊拉克夺取的土地上驱逐出去，ISIS曾在那片土地上宣布建立哈里发国，并希望以此接管世界。

sentences.en: And…
sentences.zh: 而且……

sentences.en: It looks to me and it looks to all of a lot of very talented people that do this for a living like this is
sentences.zh: 在我看来，在所有以此为生的天才人士看来，这看起来

sentences.en: going to be a storm that's going to be a very large one, far larger than we've seen in perhaps decades.
sentences.zh: 将是一场风暴，而且是一场非常大的风暴，可能比我们几十年来见过的任何风暴都要大得多。

sentences.en: On Tuesday, President Trump warned that Hurricane Florence, a Category 4 storm headed for Virginia,
sentences.zh: 周二，特朗普总统警告说，飓风“佛罗伦萨”是一场四级风暴，正向弗吉尼亚州、

sentences.en: North Carolina and South Carolina, could be the most dangerous storm to hit those states in more than 25 years.
sentences.zh: 北卡罗来纳州和南卡罗来纳州袭来，这可能是25年多来袭击这些州的最危险的风暴。

sentences.en: Things can change, but we doubt they will at this stage.
sentences.zh: 情况可能会有变化，但我们怀疑现阶段不会有太大变化。

sentences.en: It's a pretty late stage.
sentences.zh: 现在已经是相当晚的阶段了。

sentences.en: We doubt they're going to be very, very far off course.
sentences.zh: 我们怀疑它不会偏离航线太远。

sentences.en: The governors of all three states have ordered the evacuation of more than one million residents from coastal areas, fearing that the storm will produce record-setting storm surges
sentences.zh: 所有三个州的州长都已下令从沿海地区疏散超过一百万居民，担心这场风暴会产生创纪录的风暴潮

sentences.en: and catastrophic flooding.
sentences.zh: 和灾难性的洪水。

sentences.en: We are in a very deadly and important game of chess with Hurricane Florence, and what we're doing is staying one step ahead.
sentences.zh: 我们正在与飓风“佛罗伦萨”进行一场非常致命且重要的棋局，我们所做的是保持领先一步。

sentences.en: The storm is expected to make landfall on Thursday night.
sentences.zh: 预计风暴将于周四晚上登陆。
